title: Lost Lantern
description: Find the lantern left beside the old road.

title: Herb Run
description: Gather five moonleaf herbs for the village healer.

title: Quiet Bridge
description: Clear the small bridge so travelers can pass safely.

title: Message for Mira
description: Deliver a sealed letter before sunset.

title: Baker's Basket
description: Carry a basket of bread to the watchtower.

title: A Warm Fire
description: Collect three bundles of dry wood for the campers.

title: Missing Sign
description: Find the missing road sign and put it back in place.

title: Garden Patrol
description: Chase away the rabbits nibbling on the mayor's garden.

title: River Pebbles
description: Bring five smooth blue pebbles to the village mason.

title: The Locked Archive
description: Retrieve an old map from the locked archive before the council meets.

title: Stable Sweep
description: Clean the stable and refill the horses' water troughs.

title: The Red Ribbon
description: Return a red ribbon to the child who dropped it.

title: Lantern Oil
description: Deliver two bottles of oil to the night watch.

title: The Broken Ferry
description: Secure the ferry ropes and get the damaged boat back to shore.

title: Fresh Paint
description: Paint the town notice board before noon.

title: Lost Button
description: Find the brass button lost by the town clerk.

title: Tea Delivery
description: Deliver a warm tin of tea to the retired captain.

title: Fence Fix
description: Replace three loose fence posts around the meadow.

title: Blue Potatoes
description: Pick a basket of blue potatoes for the innkeeper.

title: Storm on the Ridge
description: Reach the ridge and relight the warning beacon before nightfall.

title: Clean the Fountain
description: Remove the leaves and stones from the town fountain.

title: The Spare Key
description: Take the spare gate key to the evening guard.

title: Miller's Flour
description: Carry one sack of flour from the mill to the bakery.

title: Warm Blankets
description: Bring two blankets to travelers waiting by the bridge.

title: The Sealed Well
description: Find the missing seal and close the abandoned well before it floods.

title: Watch the Kettle
description: Keep an eye on the cook's kettle while she shops.

title: Return the Net
description: Return a fisher's net found beside the riverbank.

title: Count the Chickens
description: Count the farm chickens and report the missing ones.

title: The Dragon's Debt
description: Climb the pass and recover the village's stolen bell from a dragon's hoard.

title: Sunset Post
description: Place the evening notice on the roadside post.
